name: Steelsnap's Rib
summary: In Thousand Needles, Steelsnap's Rib marks the end of a feared hyena's reign. Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff wants the bone brought to Hunter Rise as proof that Steelsnap has been slain.

sections.title: A Hunt Outside the Blessing
sections.body: Tauren hunts often seek food, honor, or harmony with nature. Steelsnap is different. The alpha hyena roams the canyon floor south of Camp E'thok in Thousand Needles, terrorizing peaceful wildlife and rallying lesser predators to bloodshed. Hunt master Melor Stonehoof, on Hunter Rise, marks Steelsnap for death. He asks for the hyena's rib as proof the tyrant is slain and the canyon cleansed of its blight.

faq.q: What is Steelsnap's Rib used for?
aliases: what do i do with steelsnaps rib
faq.answer: Bring the rib to Melor Stonehoof on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff. It proves Steelsnap has been defeated.

faq.q: Where can I find Steelsnap to get the rib?
faq.answer: Steelsnap roams the canyon floor in northwestern Thousand Needles, south of Camp E'thok. Loyal packmates often flank him.

faq.q: Why does Melor Stonehoof want Steelsnap killed?
faq.answer: Melor considers Steelsnap an unnatural tyrant outside the Earthmother's blessing. The hyena spreads bloodshed and fear among peaceful beasts, unlike predators that hunt for survival.
Melor Stonehoof is a veteran tauren hunter on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff. He sends aspiring trackers after dangerous beasts across Kalimdor.

angles.text: As a hunter, tracking down Steelsnap tests your skill against a dangerous pack leader and helps cull a threat to the wild's balance.
As a tauren, bringing back Steelsnap's Rib fulfills your duty to the Earthmother by purging a cruel creature that taints the sacred balance.
